entries.text: Over here![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.text: Anyone can be a Pokémon Trainer as long as\nthey have Pokémon by their side![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_23

entries.text: And it’s our duty as Trainers to help our Pokémon\ngrow stronger through battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_24

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So, you ready to battle me,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_01

entries.text: Oye! Don’t get cold feet on me now! I wanna see\nwhat you’ve got![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_02

entries.text: Perfecto! I’m so excited! For this battle,\nI think I’ll use—[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_03

entries.text: Miss Nemona.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I trust you remember that M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]
is
wholly
inexperienced
in
Pokémon battling?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_02

entries.text: Heh, whoops... Good call, Director.\c\nI was about to send out one of my usual partners\nright off the bat...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_04

entries.text: I guess I’ll take this chance to try out my new\nbuddy instead![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_05

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]C’mon, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Let’s have us
a
fruitful
battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_06

entries.text: Look at you, winning your first battle ever!\nYou’ve got even more potential than I thought!\r\nYou’re gonna be a strong Trainer for sure![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_07a

entries.text: Hey, if you can battle like that on your first try,\nyou definitely have what it takes to be a Trainer![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_07b

entries.text: But now I want to try a different strategy!\nLet’s go again—just one more battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_08

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)] and h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser

from

entries.text: Ah, sorry! I got kinda caught up in all the\nexcitement...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

to
your
[VAR 0x0101(0001)], too.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.text: Don’t worry about it
entries.label: common_0090_select_01

entries.text: Let’s battle again soon!
entries.label: common_0090_select_02

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Heh... All right!\nThanks, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_11a

entries.text: Oh, definitely! We’ll definitely battle more![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_11b

entries.text: You two seem to be becoming fast friends,\nthough you’ve only just met.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_04

entries.text:
Can I count on you to take your new schoolmate
here under your wing, Miss Nemona?\c
I’m sure [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she can learn a great deal from a
Champion-ranked Trainer, such as yourself.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_05

entries.text: You bet, sir![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_12

entries.text: Oh, that reminds me! Since you’re new to training\nPokémon, there’s an app you definitely need![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_13

entries.text: You have a smartphone, right? Lemme see it\nfor a sec.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_14

entries.text: The [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Pokédex app[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] was added to your\nRotom Phone!
entries.label: common_0090_system_01

entries.text: The Pokédex will automatically register any\nPokémon you catch.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_15

entries.text: It’s a must-have for Pokémon Trainers!\c\nIt’s a super handy app! Our homeroom teacher,\nMr. Jacq, actually made it himself![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_16

entries.text: Back in my day, we used ordinary paper and\nhandwritten notes to compile our Pokédexes.\r\nIt’s quite the age we live in now.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_06

entries.text: Oof! Filling out a Pokédex by hand? I can’t even\nimagine how much work that would take![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_17

entries.text: Ohoho... No, I suppose you can’t.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_07

entries.text: Yet no matter how much the times may change,\nthe wonder of meeting new Pokémon never does.\r\nThat is a truly timeless pleasure.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_08

entries.text: And the more Pokémon that you encounter, the\nmore you’ll find yourself growing and changing.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_09

entries.text: I hope you will both work hard toward the goal\nof completing your own Pokédexes.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_10

entries.text: Now, Miss Nemona, I do still have a few matters\nto discuss with your parents.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_11

entries.text:
